pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacco Barrel$() performs both fermentation and aging. It accepts $(item)loose tobacco$() or $(item)cured tobacco leaf$(). Fresh raw leaf and Spoiled Tobacco are rejected.

A barrel holds up to $(item)16$() items. Additional tobacco must be exactly compatible with the existing stored stack, including its components/processing data. Adding more tobacco to a batch resets its current fermentation or aging progress.
pages.title: Batch Rules

pages.text: Right-click with valid tobacco to insert as much as the barrel can accept. Right-click with an empty hand to remove the entire stored batch. Sneak-right-click prints detailed status. Spectacles provide a more compact live overlay.
pages.title: Interaction

pages.text: The barrel automatically chooses a mode from its environment. Fermentation takes priority when its requirements are met. Otherwise the barrel ages if aging conditions are valid. If neither set of conditions is valid, the barrel remains Idle.
pages.title: Automatic Modes
Create Extraction
pages.text: Create automation treats fermentation and aging differently. Fermenting is a protected finite batch, so automated extraction waits until it finishes. Aging has no universal endpoint, so it remains extractable; use an aging Attribute Filter when you want an automated cellar to wait for a specific age.
